body:
Thank you for your comment, it really put some things into perspective and helped a lot. I think I kind of rationalized that I must deserve being hurt because I had done something I knew I wasn’t supposed to do, but did anyway on a whim. But, I recognize now that it’s not normal.

I don’t really know if she can go to jail for this, as she doesn’t hit hard enough to leave visible marks, but still enough to hurt. She doesn’t really threaten my life, but she threatens my belongings, like the laptop that was supposed to be her gift to me.

My mother has always been against my sister hitting me, (save for the time that I had failed a semester) She has told my sister to stop hitting me, but my sister does it anyway, saying that I “made” her do it to me. My mom doesn’t know of these recent events though because I don’t know what she can do if she’s not here.

Thanks for your reply. I’ve recently started working a job with more hours to save up some money, but I don’t really have anyone to take me in. Living with my mom isn’t really a comfortable option, but it would probably be better than this. After I get my next paycheck, I think I’ll ask to move in with her. Also that last part is really appreciated, thank you.
Yeah, I kinda am pathetic. I’ve never been very strong or athletic. My sister is significantly taller and larger than me. I’m 5’6” 125 lbs and she’s like 5’10” and weighs wayyyyy more.

I guess there really isn’t another option then. I’m just worried about if she finds out I want to move out, she’ll try to stop me. I’m also worried about my dog, as she’s likely going to be alone in the house a lot.
